hooks.command: jq -r '.cwd // ""' | { read -r d; notify-send -a "Claude Code" -i "$HOME/.local/share/icons/claude.svg" "Claude Code — done" "Finished working in ${d##*/}"; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.message // "Claude needs your input"' | { read -r m; notify-send -u critical -a "Claude Code" -i "$HOME/.local/share/icons/claude.svg" "Claude Code — input needed" "$m"; } 2>/dev/null || true
